title: donnellsmithia tuberosa

It is a perennial herb that grows in high-altitude mountainous regions, particularly in Mexico and Central America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Donnellsmithia tuberosa contains bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
